basis: Labelled departure (GTAP 12 §12.4.2 takes the RAS prior from trade data as reported). China's 2022 customs record about 7.6 bn USD of crude from Malaysia (BACI), far above Malaysia's own crude exports (S11 export volume): Venezuelan and Iranian crude sold to China is relabelled as Malaysian after ship-to-ship transfers off Malaysia (Reuters and TankerTrackers on PDVSA cargoes 2022: about 238,000 bpd of Venezuelan crude went to Malaysia for trans-shipment to China in June 2022). With the relabelled volume on MYS to CHN, the RAS put Venezuela's unrecorded exports on its only recorded 2022 routes (VEN to ESP 10.5 bn, x21; VEN to ITA 1.9 bn, x28). The rule moves MYS to CHN prior volume above Malaysia's own export volume to VEN to CHN and IRN to CHN, in proportion to each origin's export volume its recorded routes do not carry.
